objective: Evaluate Hypothesis as a resource-bounded test-only donor for F2-WP-508 GWT re-entry/provenance falsification, with no production runtime, state, truth, cognition, or effect authority.

architecture_staleness_review.reason: The parallel WP508 E1 lane already identifies OpenTelemetry/OpenLineage as thin provenance-semantics donors. Hypothesis is therefore bounded to sequence generation, invariant checking, and counterexample reduction for a future F2-native test harness; it must not compete as provenance semantics or runtime authority.

observed_mechanisms: RuleBasedStateMachine defines rule-driven stateful tests over a system under test and supporting state
run_state_machine_as_test executes generated rule sequences and reports a minimal breaking program on failure
invariants are checked before rule execution starts and after each generated rule step according to initialization/precondition rules
settings expose max_examples and stateful_step_count as explicit work bounds; the current source default profile uses max_examples=100 and stateful_step_count=50
the current CI profile sets derandomize=true and database=None, reducing cross-run example-database state in CI
stateful_step_count is multiplicative with max_examples and therefore must be bounded explicitly for resource discipline
candidate.maintenance_signal: Official Hypothesis documentation observed current as version 6.165.10 on 2026-08-29; source identity for this result remains pinned to the exact Git commit above.

fusion_hypothesis_for_architect.statement: Wrap the future WP508 pure/frozen re-entry-provenance contract in a tiny Hypothesis RuleBasedStateMachine so generated action sequences exercise stale generation, wrong frame digest, wrong recipient, orphan predecessor/link, duplicate causal event, duplicate admission, replay, reorder, and corrupted witness cases while F2-native invariants remain the sole acceptance semantics.
proposed_invariants: no generated witness can override failed canonical F2 generation/frame/recipient binding
replayed transport/admission cannot mint a second canonical world event or effect
stale generation and corrupted provenance fail closed
accepted re-entry remains bound to exact causal event, admission, frame generation/digest, recipient, and predecessor references
rejected inputs cannot mutate canonical state or EffectJournal authority
model/workspace/GWT output remains candidate or measurement only and cannot mint truth
fusion_hypothesis_for_architect.resource_fence: Use a dedicated deterministic CI profile with low explicit max_examples and stateful_step_count, derandomize=true, database=None, and no network/provider/effect calls. Persist only the minimized failing sequence into an ordinary deterministic regression after review.
fusion_hypothesis_for_architect.authority_fence: Hypothesis is test generation only. It does not own F2 provenance IDs, UnifiedDB state, GWT semantics, model truth, EffectGate, EffectJournal, completion, or runtime authority.

counterhypothesis.statement: A small hand-authored adversarial transition matrix may cover the WP508 provenance state space well enough, making Hypothesis dependency and CI search overhead unnecessary.
counterhypothesis.cheapest_future_falsifier: In a separately claimed E2/E3 test-only lane, compare a tiny bounded RuleBasedStateMachine against the existing deterministic matrix. Adopt only if it yields at least one distinct minimized counterexample or materially closes sequence-interaction coverage without violating the fixed resource budget.

why_not_import_whole_tool: WP508 requires F2-native fail-closed provenance semantics, not a new runtime framework
Hypothesis search should never enter the production re-entry path
generated sequences are evidence-discovery inputs; only reviewed deterministic regressions should become stable acceptance tests
resource use must remain bounded because max_examples multiplied by stateful_step_count controls the approximate sequence-search budget

next_discriminator.summary: Map the already-selected OpenTelemetry/OpenLineage-derived WP508 witness fields into a pure F2 test adapter and specify the smallest RuleBasedStateMachine plus a hand-authored adversarial baseline. Do not execute it without a new Trigger-6 claim.
